verdict.rationale: Ollama runs headlessly. It installs with a one-line shell script, runs as a server with a REST API you can call via curl, ships Python and JS libraries, and exposes CLI commands like `ollama run`, `pull` and `rm`. Community reports confirm unattended server use behind bots, embedding in products, Linux inference and shipped containers. Missing for 10: explicit CI/pipeline documentation (e.g. GitHub Actions examples), documented headless/daemon configuration guidance, and a published OpenAPI spec (the probe found none).
